bio.text: Dan Barrios is a candidate for Congress in Texas's 32nd District, according to his campaign website.
The website says he was born and raised in Brownsville, has lived in North Texas for more than 25 years, and serves on the Richardson City Council, Place 3.

It says he holds an MBA in Strategic Management from the University of North Texas, worked in executive sales, later taught business courses at the high school and college level, and held leadership roles with the American Red Cross.
